get.description:
Lists customer-supplied profiles for the team with cursor pagination. Deleted profiles are omitted.

Requires a team API key with `campaigns:read`. Project tokens are not accepted.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Only profiles that carry this exact tag.

schema.description: Exact tag, 1-48 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters.

parameters.name: phonePrefix
parameters.description: Only profiles whose E.164 phone number starts with this prefix, such as `+4479`.

X-Trace-Id.description: W3C trace ID of this request. Your `traceparent` trace ID when you sent a valid one.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

get.description:
Gets one customer-supplied profile by its E.164 phone. Deleted profiles return 404.

Requires a team API key with `campaigns:read`. Project tokens are not accepted.

X-Trace-Id.description: W3C trace ID of this request. Your `traceparent` trace ID when you sent a valid one.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

put.summary: Create or update an audience profile
put.description:
Creates a bounded team profile, or replaces tags and attributes at the observed revision. A stale revision returns 409. To recreate a profile deleted in the last 30 days, send the `revision` the delete returned as `expectedRevision`; a put without it returns 409 with a message naming that revision. A consent assertion records the customer's statement; it does not clear an opt-out or authorize a send. This beta requires enrollment and release eligibility.

Requires a team API key with `campaigns:manage`. Project tokens are not accepted.

expectedRevision.description: Required to edit or recreate a deleted profile; omit only for first creation.

X-Trace-Id.description: W3C trace ID of this request. Your `traceparent` trace ID when you sent a valid one.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

delete.description:
Removes profile fields, consent assertions and reusable audience-list memberships at the observed revision, and clears the preview row of each audience the phone belonged to. Recipients already added to campaigns (including drafts), previously uploaded files and opt-outs are not changed. The phone's deletion record is kept for 30 days; `revision` is its revision. During that time, adding the phone to an audience returns 409, and recreating the profile requires `expectedRevision` set to this revision. Deletion remains available after beta withdrawal.

Requires a team API key with `campaigns:manage`. Project tokens are not accepted.

parameters.name: expectedRevision
parameters.description: The profile revision you last read. A different current revision returns 409.

X-Trace-Id.description: W3C trace ID of this request. Your `traceparent` trace ID when you sent a valid one.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

get.description:
Lists the customer's recorded campaign consent assertions for one profile. Assertions do not override opt-outs.

Requires a team API key with `campaigns:read`. Project tokens are not accepted.

X-Trace-Id.description: W3C trace ID of this request. Your `traceparent` trace ID when you sent a valid one.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

post.summary: Start an audience profile CSV import
post.description:
Queues a bounded CSV import of customer-supplied team profiles. Exact CSV header names can be mapped to profile fields. At most one import is active per team. Files contain at most 10 MiB and 10,000 rows; the CSV is removed after completion or cancellation. The same replay key, file and mapping return the existing job. Requires beta enrollment.

Requires a team API key with `campaigns:manage`. Project tokens are not accepted.

csvBase64.description: UTF-8 CSV encoded as standard padded base64; decoded file at most 10 MiB and 10,000 data rows. The `tags` cell holds a JSON array of strings and the `attributes` cell a JSON object, quoted as CSV requires, for example `+15550100001,"[""vip""]","{""city"":""Lisbon""}"`.

mapping.description: Maps profile fields to exact CSV header names. Required when the CSV uses different headers; unmapped CSV columns are ignored.

X-Trace-Id.description: W3C trace ID of this request. Your `traceparent` trace ID when you sent a valid one.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

totalValid.description: Rows that passed validation and will be written.

invalidCount.description: Rows refused by validation; `invalidSamples` lists up to 20.

conflictCount.description: Valid rows not written because of the team's profile quota or a revision conflict; `conflictSamples` lists up to 20.

get.summary: Get an audience profile import report
get.description:
Returns aggregate counts and up to 20 row-number/reason samples. Raw phone numbers and custom values are not included. Reports expire 30 days after completion or cancellation.

Requires a team API key with `campaigns:read`. Project tokens are not accepted.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

invalidCount.description: Rows refused by validation; `invalidSamples` lists up to 20.

Requires a team API key with `campaigns:manage`. Project tokens are not accepted.
